title: Two epic-reconciler release tests flake: the room is observed before the Workflow's post-terminal release steps land
body: In 8 runs of `npx vitest run test/epic-reconciler.test.ts test/runs.test.ts`, two different tests failed once each (~25% of runs showed one failure): 'releases the dispatch lease on its way out…' (expects room.leaseStatus() null at epic-reconciler.test.ts:2164) and 'completes a pass's writes under the re-acquired token after the lease lapses (tick e9n)' (expects room.slotStatus() null at :2283). Both poll the terminal CHECKPOINT and then read the room immediately — but release-publish-slot / release-dispatch-lease run as steps AFTER the terminal checkpoint is written (epic-reconciler.ts:1708-1733), so the observation races the release. This is the exact ox0 shape ('absence right after creation is not-yet'): the tests should wait on the release's own durable evidence, because a gate that runs this file can fail innocent trees.
